hints: Differentiate displacement $s = 2t^2 - \frac{80}{3}t^{3/2}$ with respect to $t$ to find velocity $v(t)$.
Differentiate velocity $v(t)$ with respect to $t$ to find acceleration $a(t)$.
Set $a(t) = 0$ and solve the resulting equation for $t$.
walkthrough:
Differentiate displacement $s(t)$ with respect to $t$ to obtain velocity $v(t)$:
$$v(t) = \frac{ds}{dt} = 4t - \frac{80}{3}\left(\frac{3}{2}t^{1/2}\right) = 4t - 40t^{1/2}$$

Differentiate velocity with respect to $t$ to obtain acceleration $a(t)$:
$$a(t) = \frac{dv}{dt} = 4 - 40\left(\frac{1}{2}t^{-1/2}\right) = 4 - 20t^{-1/2} = 4 - \frac{20}{\sqrt{t}}$$

Set acceleration to zero and solve for $t$:
$$4 - \frac{20}{\sqrt{t}} = 0 \implies \frac{20}{\sqrt{t}} = 4 \implies 4\sqrt{t} = 20 \implies \sqrt{t} = 5 \implies t = 25\text{ s}$$
teacher_walkthrough:
Velocity is the derivative of displacement with respect to time:
$$v(t) = \frac{ds}{dt} = \frac{d}{dt}\left(2t^2 - \frac{80}{3}t^{3/2}\right) = 4t - \frac{80}{3} \times \frac{3}{2}t^{1/2} = 4t - 40t^{1/2}$$

Acceleration is the derivative of velocity with respect to time:
$$a(t) = \frac{dv}{dt} = \frac{d}{dt}\left(4t - 40t^{1/2}\right) = 4 - 40 \times \frac{1}{2}t^{-1/2} = 4 - 20t^{-1/2}$$

Rewrite $20t^{-1/2}$ as $\frac{20}{\sqrt{t}}$ and set acceleration to zero:
$$4 - \frac{20}{\sqrt{t}} = 0$$
$$4 = \frac{20}{\sqrt{t}}$$

Square both sides to find $t$:
$$t = 5^2 = 25\text{ s}$$

hints: Substitute $t = 25\text{ s}$ into the displacement formula $s = 2t^2 - \frac{80}{3}t^{3/2}$.
Substitute $t = 25\text{ s}$ into the velocity formula $v = 4t - 40t^{1/2}$.
walkthrough:
Substitute $t = 25\text{ s}$ into the velocity equation:
$$v(25) = 4(25) - 40(25^{1/2}) = 100 - 40(5) = 100 - 200 = -100\text{ m s}^{-1}$$

teacher_walkthrough:
Substitute $t = 25\text{ s}$ into the velocity equation $v(t) = 4t - 40\sqrt{t}$:
$$v(25) = 4(25) - 40\sqrt{25} = 100 - 40(5) = 100 - 200 = -100\text{ m s}^{-1}$$

State the final values:
$$\text{Displacement} = -\frac{6250}{3}\text{ m} = -2083.3\text{ m}, \quad \text{Velocity} = -100\text{ m s}^{-1}$$
